premise: Mouse squeaks hello into the hollow tree and a giant voice answers; Deer and Rabbit come to see; the giant is Mouse's own echo, and he shouts again on purpose.
inspiration: Folk echo tales (The Dog and the Echo), turned: nothing to fear in the hollow; the biggest voice in the forest turns out to be the smallest friend's own.
lesson: The big scary thing is often just you, coming back.

en-US.title: Mouse and the Big Echo
en-US.text: Mouse {mouse:pulse} found a hole in the old tree. {tree:pulse} A big, round hole. [curious] He put his nose in. Nothing. His whole head. Still nothing. So he took a deep breath and squeaked. Hello! And the tree answered. HELLO… hello… hello… [gasps] Mouse jumped back. {mouse:hop} Somebody very big lives in there! Deer {deer:pulse} came to see. Rabbit {rabbit:hop x2} came to see. Deer knocked with one hoof. {sfx:knock} Knock knock. KNOCK KNOCK… knock knock… [whispers] It knocks back, whispered Rabbit. {rabbit:shake 0.5} Mouse's whiskers wobbled. {mouse:wobble} Then he had an idea. He squeaked one more time, a silly squeak. Wibble-wobble-boo! And the tree said… WIBBLE-WOBBLE-BOO… wobble-boo… boo… [laughs] Mouse laughed. It is ME! said Mouse. My own voice, coming back to say hello! Rabbit tried. Hop… hop… hop… Deer tried. Hmmm… hmmm… [happily] And they took turns all afternoon, being the biggest voices in the forest.

es-ES.title: Ratón y el gran eco
es-ES.text: Ratón {mouse:pulse} encontró un agujero en el árbol viejo. {tree:pulse} Un agujero grande y redondo. [curious] Metió la nariz. Nada. Metió la cabeza entera. Nada. Así que cogió aire y chilló. ¡Hola! Y el árbol contestó. HOLA… hola… hola… [gasps] Ratón dio un salto atrás. {mouse:hop} ¡Ahí dentro vive alguien muy grande! Ciervo {deer:pulse} vino a ver. Conejo {rabbit:hop x2} vino a ver. Ciervo llamó con la pezuña. {sfx:knock} Toc, toc. TOC, TOC… toc, toc… [whispers] Contesta, susurró Conejo. {rabbit:shake 0.5} A Ratón le temblaron los bigotes. {mouse:wobble} Entonces tuvo una idea. Chilló otra vez, un chillido de risa. ¡Chiribí-chiribú! Y el árbol dijo… CHIRIBÍ-CHIRIBÚ… chiribú… bú… [laughs] Ratón se rio. ¡Soy YO!, dijo. ¡Es mi propia voz, que vuelve a saludarme! Conejo probó. Hop… hop… hop… Ciervo probó. Mmm… mmm… [happily] Y pasaron toda la tarde turnándose para ser las voces más grandes del bosque.

knock.prompt: two soft knocks on a hollow tree trunk, woody and resonant, with a faint echo
